market_question: Will PSG win the 2025–26 Champions League?
reasoning: Even as one of the strongest clubs, PSG's true win probability in a 36-team Champions League is at most ~20%, given historical parity, the randomness of knockout ties, and the presence of rivals like Real Madrid, Manchester City, and Bayern. The market-implied 58.5% vastly overstates PSG's overwhelming dominance, making No the clear value side.
evidence_points: In the past decade, the pre-season favorite never exceeded 25% implied probability; no team has repeated as champion since Real Madrid in 2017.
PSG's 2024-25 success (semifinal/final) was impressive but still reliant on a collective system without a single transcendent star, limiting their ceiling relative to super-clubs.
The expanded format increases the number of high-leverage knockout matches, raising the odds of an early exit for any one team.
